senses.gloss: to close, press.—Part. pass. קָלוּט; f. קְלוּטָה; pl. קְלוּטִים; קְלוּטיֹת. Sifra Emor, Par. 7, ch. VII (expl. קלוט, Lev. XXII, 23) פרסוֹת וכ׳ an animal whose hoofs resemble those of a horse &c.; Bekh. VI, 7 (40ᵃ) שרגליו ק׳ וכ׳.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 6a:18">Bekh. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>פרסותיה ק׳</he> its hoofs are closed, opp. <he>סדוקות</he> cloven.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">Ib. VII, 6</cite> <he>אצבעותיו … או ק׳ וכ׳</he> if his fingers lie one above the other or are grown together up to the root (<cite ref="Q01982"><he>פֶּרֶק</he></cite>).
Y. Sot. IX, 23ᵈ; a. e.—In gen. קָלוּט an animal with uncloven hoofs (having the sign of uncleanness) born of a clean animal, monster or hybrid.
Bekh. 7ᵃ ק׳ בן פרה a ḳaluṭ born of a cow; Ḥull. 68ᵇ.
Ib. ק׳ במעי פרה a ḳaluṭ found in a cow (after ritual slaughtering); ib. 69ᵃ.
Sabb. 67ᵃ זרעיך כק׳ וכפרדה וכ׳ thy seed be like a ḳ. and like a mule &c. (Rashi: ‘like one whose semen is locked up’); a. e.

senses.gloss: to clutch, intercept, receive; to conceive, retain, absorb.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 65a:3">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>כל עוף הקוֹלֵט מן האויר וכ׳</he> any bird that snatches in the air (for things thrown to it) is unclean.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:6">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> <he>אינה קוֹלֶטֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01575"><he>פֶּרֶד</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 5a:101">Ker. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>וק׳ את הריח</he> and the oil retained (absorbed) the scent.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:3">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>קְלָטָן הים</he> the sea absorbed them (the waters of the rivers); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 848:1">Yalk. Ps. 848</cite> <he>קְלָטָם</he>.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:15">Ab. V, 15</cite> <he>שמוציאה את היין וקולטת וכ׳</he> which passes the wine and retains the lees; <he>שמוציאה … וק׳ את הסולת</he> which passes the common flour and retains the fine flour (v. <cite ref="R00216"><he>צוּף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:7">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שהתיבה קוֹלַטְתּוֹ</he> whatever animal the ark received.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:6">Sabb. I, 6</cite> <he>כדי שיִקְלוֹט העין</he> when there is time enough before the Sabbath for the wool to assume the color of the dye.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:8">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>אין האשה קולטת וכ׳</he> a woman conceives only shortly after menstruation.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:6">Shebi. II, 6</cite> <he>כל הרכבה שאינה קולטת וכ׳</he> a grafting which does not take root within three days, will never do so; a. v. fr.—
Ex. R. s. 1 ק׳ דרך וכ׳ he (Moses) adopted the manner of his ancestors (finding wives at the well); Tanḥ. Sh’moth 10 לקח.—Esp. (v. מִקְלָט) to protect, give the shelter of an asylum.

<cite ref="Makkot 12a:3">Macc. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>אינו קולט אלא גגו</he> only the top of the altar protects him that flees to it; <he>אינו קולט … עולמים</he> only the altar of the permanent sanctuary (in Jerusalem) offers protection; <he>אינו קולט אלא כהן וכ׳</he> protects only the priest while at service &c.

<cite ref="Makkot 12a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אינה קולטת אלא בצר</he> only Bezer is an asylum (but not Bozrah). Ib.ᵇ <he>פלכו קוֹלְטוֹ</he> his (the Levite’s) district protects him. Ib. <he>עיר שקְלָטַתּוּ כבר</he> a town which has received him once before.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 160:2">Sifré Num. 160</cite> <he>אין לי אלא שקוֹלְטוֹת בארץ</he> this would indicate only that they (these cities) offer asylum for manslaughter committed in Palestine.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 160:2">Ib.</cite> <he>לא קָלְטָה אחת מהם עד וכ׳</he> none of those cities had the right of asylum until all of them had been designated; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Makkot 10a:11">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>מנין … קוֹלְטִין</he> whence do you learn that the words of the Law offer protection (to its students)?; <cite ref="Makkot 10a:13">ib.</cite> <he>קולטין ממלאך וכ׳</he> they protect from the angel of death.

senses.gloss: (of sacred precincts) to retain; to make export illegal. Ib. 19ᵇ קְלָטוּהוּ מחיצות the sacred precincts have retained it (and it cannot be redeemed and taken out of Jerusalem again); ib. 20ᵃ. Ib. מחיצה לִקְלוֹט דרבנן that the precincts have retaining power is merely a rabbinical enactment; Snh. 113ᵃ; B. Mets. 53ᵇ.—Part. pass. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 4a">Sabb. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קלוטה כמי שהונחה דמיא</he>, v. <cite ref="N00340"><he>נוּחַ</he></cite>.
